symbols.name: WithFilterSchema(RouteHandlerBuilder, bool)
symbols.summary: Adds OpenAPI documentation for the FilterModel to the endpoint.
symbols.remarks: Usage examples: 1. For GET endpoint with query parameter: filter={"page":1,"pageSize":10,"filters":[{"field":"name","operator":"eq","value":"John"}],"orderings":[{"field":"createdAt","direction":"desc"}]} app.MapGet("/api/users/search", async (HttpContext context, ...) => { var filter = await context.FromQueryFilterAsync(); // ... }) .WithName("SearchUsers") .WithOpenApi(operation => { operation.Summary = "Search users"; return operation; }) .WithFilterSchema(); 2. For POST endpoint with request body: content={"page":1,"pageSize":10,"filters":[{"field":"name","operator":"eq","value":"John"}],"orderings":[{"field":"createdAt","direction":"desc"}]} app.MapPost("/api/users/search", async (HttpContext context, ...) => { var filter = await context.FromBodyFilterAsync(); // ... }) .WithName("SearchUsersPost") .WithOpenApi(operation => { operation.Summary = "Search users"; return operation; }) .WithFilterSchema(isRequestBody: true);

syntax.content: public static RouteHandlerBuilder WithFilterSchema(this RouteHandlerBuilder builder, bool isRequestBody = false)

parameters.description: If true, documents the filter as a request body. If false, documents it as a query parameter.

returns.description: The route handler builder for method chaining.
